description: Bucketed traffic series (visitors, pageviews, bounce, session time per bucket). Optional filters: JSON array [{ "d": "country", "o": "is", "v": ["DE"] }]. Values OR within a dimension, AND across dimensions. Region uses country:region (e.g. US:CA). granularity is hourly | daily | weekly | monthly (coerced to what the period allows). On cookieless sites newVisitors and returningVisitors are null — the API notes field says: "newVisitors and returningVisitors are null: cookieless visitor hashes rotate daily, so new vs returning would be a salt artifact, not a person." Read-only.

filters.description: Dashboard filters as JSON array, e.g. [{ "d": "country", "o": "is", "v": ["DE"] }]. Values within a dimension are OR'd; dimensions are AND'd. Region values are country:region (e.g. US:CA).

format.description: Output shape: table (default) or raw json.

name: get_timeseries
